book.name: Suun
book.title: Mɓe ɗe Jesu Kristi woo nJoon ndǝǝn Suun

content: Ngulep Naan ɗepaat wur tàa feer wur, ɓe nghan naa mee zar ɗe nǝ tong a ɗengnan sham taa ɓǝm-yil nǝ. Mo shin biwangpee nzar nǝ mǝ tuun ɗejurum, ɗe baa nǝ kǝ peeɗar sǝ kas nwur.
Kaaɗe wur wang pwoo tuun ɗejurum ɗesǝ nǝ, ɓe ɗyeel kàa put ndǝǝn tuun nǝ, kaa ɗyeel wus ɗe nǝ se lu sǝ. Ɗiyeel ɗesǝ nǝ kàa paa puus, kǝ ɗengnaan, mbe pee nǝ rap kaa par sǝ.
nƊǝǝn ɗyeel ɗesǝ nǝ, ɓe ciɓel mo sham nkaa yil nǝ, mo shín ɓal mo kaa mǝ ɗoor mo sǝ.
Mo sat mo, << taji wu tung shit, koo tǝng, kǝ bii ɗǝ mo kop mo ɗe mo ndǝǝn yil nǝ kas, mɓe wu tung a nen ɗe baa mo kǝ mbii luwas mǝ Naan pǝkyeen mo kas.
Baa mo shin iiko nǝ mo a mbǝkǝ mo twe nen ɗesǝ nǝ mo kas, mɓe mo shin iiko nǝ mo, a mbǝkǝ mo shinjeel ɗe nen ɗesǝ nǝ mo mbǝ tar mo paat. Jeel ɗe mo shwaa nǝ, nǝ shwal kaa shwal ɗe ɗoor pus gurum sǝ.
nƊǝǝn tar ɗepaat ɗesǝ nǝ mo, ɓe nen ɗesǝ nǝ mo yap muut, mɓe baa mo kat kas. Moo rǝɓet muut mɓe muut nǝ dǝm jong kǝ mo.
Ciɓel ɗesǝ nǝ mo lapshak kǝ bǝring ɗe mo tap ɗak mo mbǝ dǝm nlek. Mo jwal mee mbii mo nkáa mo, kaa mbiikáa ɗe mo ɗak mo shi zinariya sǝ, kǝ zak, yit mo lapshak kǝ yit ngurum mo.
Shwepkáa mo, a kaa mǝ shurep mo sǝ, kǝ zak, oos mo nǝ a kaa oos mǝ mbwoor mo sǝ.
Mo paa tuur mo nǝ mo, shi shool, kǝ cáap mo mo wal nciit kǝ wal mǝ shii bǝring ɗe moo dul keke bǝring mo mbǝ dǝm nlek.
Mo kǝ nɗang ɗe nii pwaspee kaa ɗoor mo sǝ. A shi ndang ɗesǝ mo, ɓe mo katɓal mbǝ shinjeel gurum mo, mbǝ tar mo paat.
Mo kǝ gwe ɗǝ a kaa mishkoom mo a ngulep mǝ tuun ɗejurum, ɗe baa nǝ kǝ peeɗar kas sǝ, sǝm wur shi Yahudi, a Abaaddon, ɗangɓe sǝm wur shi Heleni a Apoliyon. Shi mǝnǝ a nǝnee, <<Ngutǝkook kǝ mbii mo.>>
Jeel ɗeɗes ɗinshee nǝ ɗel mmǝnǝ. Ɗee jeel ɗeɗes mo ɗe vǝl, ɗe mo ndang jì.
Ngulep kǝ Naan ɗepeemee nǝ wur tàa feer wur, ɗangɓe nghan kǝlǝng mee ɗoo nǝ jì put ndǝǝn kwang ɗefeer mǝ peewus mbezuum ɗe mo ɗak nǝ a shi zinariya, ɗe nǝ ɗar ntoom Naan.
Ɗoo nǝ katpwoo ngulep ɗepeemee ɗǝ wur kǝ feer nǝ nǝ nǝnee, <<A fween nenlep ɗefeer sǝ mo, ɗe gyet mo ɓwoot mo le ngǝyen Yufrates ɗeɗes sǝ.>>
Nenlep ɗefeer ɗesǝ mo, mo gyet bwet mo a mbe pee ɗesǝ, kǝ teer, kǝ tar, kǝ ɓit nǝ, gyet mo ɓwet mo, kǝ mo twe gurum ɗe nyil nǝ mo mǝndong kaa kun.
Ɗuu shiiton ɗe mo lang bǝring nǝ mo a miliyon kambil vǝl. Wen kǝlǝng ɗuu mo nǝ

Bǝring nǝ mo kǝ nenlang nǝ mo, ɗe wen naa mo ndǝǝn suun fen nǝ, mo lap kǝsǝ, gwat tuur mo, ɗe nǝ naat kaa wus sǝ, nǝ tǝp kaa ɗengnaan sǝ, kǝ zak, nǝ a kaa fwat wus sǝ. Káa bǝring nǝ mo lapshak kǝ mǝ nvar mo. Wus kǝ ɗiyeel, kǝ fwat wus mo jì put mpwoo kǝ bǝring nǝ mo.
Mǝnɗong kaa kun mǝ gurum ɗe nyil nǝ mo mo murep mbe mbii shin jeel ɗekun ɗesǝ mo, wus nǝ, kǝ ɗiyeel, kǝ fwat wus ɗe pwat pwoo bǝring nǝ mo.
Ɓal bǝring nǝ mo, a nɗǝǝn pwoo mo, kǝ ndang mo mo. Dang mo nǝ mo a kaa nwòo mo sǝ, ɗe mo kǝ káa. A shi nɗang ɗesǝ nǝ mo, ɓe bǝring ɗesǝ mo cínjeel gurum ɗe nyil mo.

Kaar gurum ɗe baa mo murǝp nsar kǝ jeel ɗesǝ mo kas, ɓe baa mo tuwap kas, mo sat a nseyil nriin ɗebish mo, kǝ kùm ɗe mo ɗak shi zinariya, kǝ azurfa, kǝ bòng ɗenaat, kǝ jwak, kǝ yoom mo. Baa moo naapee, koo kǝlǝngpee, koo mee mwaan kas.
Baa mo waa tuwap mbǝ tukáa ɗe moo cin nǝ kas, kǝ mulak, mo kǝ shin ngaa, kǝ wat.
